import Mathlib

structure BinaryMaxHeap where
  storage : List Int
deriving Inhabited

namespace BinaryMaxHeap

def len (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Nat :=
  h.storage.length

def get (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (i : Nat) : Int :=
  h.storage.getD i 0 -- Safe access with default

def parent (i : Nat) : Nat := (i - 1) / 2

def is_heap (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, 0 < i ∧ i < h.len → h.get i ≤ h.get (parent i)

def view (h : BinaryMaxHeap) : Multiset Int :=
  Multiset.ofList h.storage

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def push_precond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_heap h ∧ h.len < 1023 -- Limited capacity as per spec example
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def insertDesc (v : Int) : List Int → List Int
  | [] => [v]
  | x :: xs => if x ≤ v then v :: x :: xs else x :: insertDesc v xs

def sortDesc : List Int → List Int
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => insertDesc x (sortDesc xs)
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def push (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : push_precond h v) : BinaryMaxHeap :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  ⟨sortDesc (v :: h.storage)⟩
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def push_postcond (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int) (result : BinaryMaxHeap)
    (_ : push_precond h v) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_heap result ∧
  result.len = h.len + 1 ∧
  result.view = h.view + {v}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma insertDesc_perm (v : Int) (l : List Int) :
    List.Perm (insertDesc v l) (v :: l) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases hx : x ≤ v
    · simp only [insertDesc]
      rw [if_pos hx]
    · simp only [insertDesc]
      rw [if_neg hx]
      have p1 : List.Perm (x :: insertDesc v xs) (x :: v :: xs) := ih.cons x
      have p2 : List.Perm (x :: v :: xs) (v :: x :: xs) := List.Perm.swap v x xs
      exact p1.trans p2

lemma sortDesc_perm (l : List Int) : List.Perm (sortDesc l) l := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Perm.refl _
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : sortDesc (x :: xs) = insertDesc x (sortDesc xs) := rfl
    rw [h1]
    have p1 : List.Perm (insertDesc x (sortDesc xs)) (x :: sortDesc xs) :=
      insertDesc_perm x _
    have p2 : List.Perm (x :: sortDesc xs) (x :: xs) := ih.cons x
    exact p1.trans p2

lemma insertDesc_sorted (v : Int) : ∀ (l : List Int),
    l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) →
    (insertDesc v l).Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _; simp [insertDesc]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro hs
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hs
    simp only [insertDesc]
    by_cases hx : x ≤ v
    · rw [if_pos hx, List.pairwise_cons]
      constructor
      · intro b hb
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb with rfl | hb'
        · exact hx
        · exact le_trans (hs.1 b hb') hx
      · exact List.pairwise_cons.mpr hs
    · rw [if_neg hx, List.pairwise_cons]
      refine ⟨?_, ih hs.2⟩
      intro b hb
      have hb' : b ∈ v :: xs := (insertDesc_perm v xs).subset hb
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hb' with rfl | hb''
      · omega
      · exact hs.1 b hb''

lemma sortDesc_sorted (l : List Int) :
    (sortDesc l).Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) := by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have h1 : sortDesc (x :: xs) = insertDesc x (sortDesc xs) := rfl
    rw [h1]
    exact insertDesc_sorted x _ ih

lemma mem_getD : ∀ (l : List Int) (i : Nat), i < l.length → l.getD i 0 ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro i hi; simp at hi
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro i hi
    cases i with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n =>
      have hn : n < xs.length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
        omega
      have h2 := ih n hn
      simp only [List.getD_cons_succ]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h2

lemma pairwise_getD : ∀ (l : List Int), l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a) →
    ∀ (i j : Nat), i < j → j < l.length → l.getD j 0 ≤ l.getD i 0 := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro _ i j _ hj; simp at hj
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro hs i j hij hj
    rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hs
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      cases j with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (by omega)
      | succ n =>
        have hn : n < xs.length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
          omega
        simp only [List.getD_cons_zero, List.getD_cons_succ]
        exact hs.1 _ (mem_getD xs n hn)
    | succ m =>
      cases j with
      | zero => exact absurd hij (by omega)
      | succ n =>
        have hn : n < xs.length := by
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hj
          omega
        simp only [List.getD_cons_succ]
        exact ih hs.2 m n (by omega) hn

lemma sorted_desc_is_heap (l : List Int)
    (hs : l.Pairwise (fun a b : Int => b ≤ a)) : is_heap { storage := l } := by
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨hi0, hilen⟩ := hi
  have hlen : i < l.length := hilen
  have hpi : parent i < i := by
    unfold parent
    omega
  show l.getD i 0 ≤ l.getD (parent i) 0
  exact pairwise_getD l hs (parent i) i hpi hlen
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem push_postcond_satisfied (h : BinaryMaxHeap) (v : Int)
    (h_precond : push_precond h v) :
    push_postcond h v (push h v h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hperm : List.Perm (sortDesc (v :: h.storage)) (v :: h.storage) :=
    sortDesc_perm _
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact sorted_desc_is_heap _ (sortDesc_sorted _)
  · show (sortDesc (v :: h.storage)).length = h.storage.length + 1
    rw [hperm.length_eq]
    simp
  · show Multiset.ofList (sortDesc (v :: h.storage)) = Multiset.ofList h.storage + {v}
    have h1 : Multiset.ofList (sortDesc (v :: h.storage))
        = Multiset.ofList (v :: h.storage) := Quot.sound hperm
    have h2 : Multiset.ofList (v :: h.storage)
        = v ::ₘ Multiset.ofList h.storage := rfl
    rw [h1, h2, add_comm (Multiset.ofList h.storage) ({v} : Multiset Int),
      Multiset.singleton_add]
  -- !benchmark @end proof

end BinaryMaxHeap
